meta.title: Big Ears
meta.subtitle: The big-eared European champions’ cup in flat silver, handles and all.
meta.footer: The famous silhouette at half scale — about 37 cm tall — half the real trophy. The cup is a surface of revolution: plinth, stem, a bowl that swells to its shoulder, then a waisted neck and flared rim with a hollow mouth. The two oversized handles are true brick arches, each anchored to the shoulder and the neck. Flat silver throughout, like the silver-plated original, finished smooth with tile caps and 45° slopes.
